{07 14 00}This store is soooo clean
and nice! I just love it
here, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

ja kena! Mulle lihtsalt

{07 16 00}Weeell... I guess I don't
HAVE to buy anything today.

{07 0c 00}Maybe I should swing by
{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00}'s store!{01 00 00 05 00} I bet he
has something, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{07 00 00}

täna midagi ostma.

{07 0c 00}Ehk peaksin põikama
{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nooki{ff 00 00 00} poodi!{01 00 00 05 00} Kindlasti
